note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Lower half gains mottled white/grey blotches absent from the smooth original; 1:1 crop reads soft.
flags.fix: Cut lab-inject strength in the bright lower zone; keep the dotted rivet rows crisp; check for stamp repeats.

flags.problem: Horizontal grain streaks on every course make it read as planks or stone rather than brick.
flags.fix: Remove the horizontal libgrain stretch; keep the vertical joints and per-block tone variation, with grain aligned to block faces.

flags.problem: exact: silhouette IoU 0.81 < 0.85; no real detail gain over a smooth enlargement (1.11x)
flags.fix: make it pass the gate honestly, or mark(...) it if it cannot
